'''Myrum Geddis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]].

==Biography==
Geddis was born in about [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]]. He founded and ran the [[Geddis mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Prakith. During his time there, he sighted some mysterious beings down the mines, who, unknown to him, were the [[Stereb]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], control of the mine was transferred over to the [[Thaarke Corporation]] and Geddis was resigned to drowning his sorrows in the [[Mother Lode Cantina]], in [[Prak City]].
